title: B8: Apply sentence case to IngredientsView and CookwareView
description: In IngredientsView.swift, apply .sentenceCased to ingredient name display strings in the list rows. In CookwareView.swift, apply .sentenceCased to cookware name display strings. The transformation is view-layer only — the underlying Ingredient.name and Cookware.name values from CookbookCore are NOT modified. Inline step-text references keep the recipe's own casing as written.
acceptance_criteria: Ingredient list rows display sentence-cased names at render time
Cookware list rows display sentence-cased names at render time
Ingredient.name and Cookware.name model values are unchanged
Step-text inline ingredient/cookware references retain the casing written in the recipe
